description: Create a local, browser-based TypeScript recreation of the original NES Legend of Zelda, architected so a final PRD can one-shot the full implementation.

goal.ultimate: Produce a final PRD capable of one-shot generation of a playable NES-accurate Legend of Zelda clone
constraints: No copyrighted assets committed (assets generated or stubbed)

evaluationCriteria: All game mechanics specifiable without ambiguity
Minimal assumptions left to model inference

userStories.title: Define core game systems
userStories.description: As a system designer, I need all fundamental Zelda systems explicitly enumerated.
acceptanceCriteria: Player movement and collision model defined
Health, death, and continue logic defined

userStories.title: Define world and map representation
userStories.description: As a designer, I need the overworld and dungeon structure specifiable as data.

userStories.title: Define rendering and animation model
userStories.description: As a developer, I need deterministic rendering rules matching NES behavior.

userStories.title: Define input and control mapping
userStories.description: As a player, controls must mirror NES Zelda.

userStories.title: Define enemy and AI behavior system
userStories.description: As a system, enemy behaviors must be data-driven and reproducible.

userStories.title: Define progression and game state
userStories.description: As a system, game progress must persist correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: Game over and continue logic defined

userStories.title: Define audio system
userStories.description: As a player, audio should feel NES-authentic.

userStories.title: Define final one-shot PRD structure
userStories.description: As a meta-system, I need a final PRD format that can generate the full game in one pass.
acceptanceCriteria: All systems decomposed into deterministic specs

definitionOfDone: Final PRD can generate a playable Zelda NES clone
Game boots, renders overworld, allows combat, and completes a dungeon
No human intervention required beyond asset substitution
